blurb.en: Two melodic sequencers, a drum sequencer and sixteen pads. Deck saver included, which is how it stayed clean.
blurb.fi: Kaksi melodiasekvensseriä, rumpusekvensseri ja kuusitoista padia. Mukana deck saver, ja siksi se on yhä siisti.
blurb.sv: Två melodisekvensiatorer, en trumsekvensiator och sexton pads. Deck saver medföljer, och därför är den i fint skick.

pull.q: With the affordable and innovative Beatstep Pro, Arturia may have created a sequencer for the masses.

quotes.t: On switching directions, there's no mechanism to tie the switch to the pattern's end: the change kicks in immediately. This is one of several 'opportunities' to get out of sync.
quotes.s: Sound On Sound · the honest caveat

quotes.t: The one thing that can't be improved in software is the micro-USB adapter.
